mix_contract: Auditions only. No runtime mapping or user selections changed.
At integration: one warning voice per actor; stop/replace on action transition, abort, death and reset; pause freezes playback.
Movement cues are quiet, proximity-limited and throttled; no per-frame/per-leg playback. Shared movement budget at most two voices.
Attack warnings outrank footfalls and ambience. Hurt short and throttled; death once per actor. Master mute honored.
Reels use listening gaps, not a staged gameplay demonstration. New events require Engineering hooks and runtime validation.
Devil Spider: windup hook needed; haul varies with distance, stop pull/hunger on release; rapid tear inputs must not stack long tails.
Widow: cancel warning offscreen; no scream through 0.8s swoop or recovery; contact, scuttle and takeoff follow actual states.
Sputtervalve: one pressure tell per volley, actual admitted bolts only; no sound on trajectory/budget rejection.
Gratecrawler: gather before 0.3s release; impact follows physical collision, never a timed delay from launch.
Flushfiend: no invented attack warning; navigation hops and reversals do not imply safe or invulnerable states.
Gnatastrophe: shared existing ambient voice retained, all living forms dangerous; new near-pass stops at blocked/finished charge.
Clogfather: warnings fit Hard timings and outrank roars; final collapse fits 1.2s; no added sounds imply portal lore.
preserved: Approved Skitterling rat and alligator voices and v8 timing edits.
Devil Spider approved scream/burn death, all selected music and current runtime effects.
Existing recorded Sputtervalve death, Flushfiend shatter and all old auditions remain available.
Existing Gnatastrophe continuous buzz and Clogfather roars remain; new effects supplement or audition replacements.
